articles.title: US-Iran ceasefire on brink as UAE reports attacks
articles.summary: Tensions escalated between Iran and the United States as their ceasefire faltered, with both nations trading fire over the strategic Strait of Hormuz. The United Arab Emirates also reported experiencing attacks for the first time, indicating a broader regional destabilization. This renewed military engagement underscores the volatility in a critical global shipping lane.

articles.title: ‘Going Dutch’ Canceled After Two Seasons at Fox
articles.summary: Fox has officially canceled its comedy series "Going Dutch," Variety has reported. The show concluded its run after airing two seasons on the broadcaster. Its most recent season began in January 2026, culminating in what is now its series finale. This decision marks the end of the comedy series' tenure on the network.

articles.title: Live: UAE intercepts Iranian missiles for first time since ceasefire
articles.summary: The UAE Defence Ministry successfully intercepted three missiles launched from Iran, with a fourth missile crashing into the sea. Authorities issued an overnight phone alert to residents. This incident underscores ongoing regional security tensions and demonstrates the UAE's robust air defence capabilities, a crucial aspect for maintaining stability in the Middle East.
